harness-design-studio 2.0.0 model 87574b5491fd
harness-design-studio 2.0.0. Provided as is, without warranty. Verify before use.

Provided as is, without warranty of any kind. Check all results before you rely on them. See sections 15 and 16 of the GPL-3.0.

Harness Design Studio supports harness design work. Every harness design must be checked by qualified engineers under your own processes before it is built or flown.

Where the notice is: a comment line at the top of every .csv and .yaml file; a notes row (the sheet About, and under the title of a build workbook) and the print footer of every .xlsx file; a line in the title block or at the top of every drawing (.svg and .pdf); a note under the first line of every .md report. The .json files (system/export.json and system/provenance.json) and the open data cannot hold a comment: for them the notice is this file.

Pending and placeholder values stay marked in the files: pending, (example data), PLACEHOLDER, Complete: no, not checked.
